title: Sunday trading in metropolitan Perth (WA)
summary: The Retail Trading Hours Amendment Act 2012 allowed general retail shops in the Perth metropolitan area to open 11am-5pm on Sundays and most public holidays from 26 August 2012, abolishing special trading precincts.

commenced.what: Sunday trading permitted for general retail shops in metropolitan Perth

direction_rationale: Longer permitted trading hours let smaller and new retailers compete with incumbents on convenience and give consumers more choice; the PC recommended full deregulation. Effects may favour large chains able to staff extra hours.
